title: Machine Learning-Based Reconstruction for Resistive Silicon Sensors
abstract: arXiv:2607.11585v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Low-Gain Avalanche Diodes (LGADs) and AC-coupled Low-Gain Avalanche Diodes (AC-LGADs) are promising technologies for precision timing and four-dimensional tracking. In AC-LGADs, the AC pad is coupled to the resistive n$^{+}$ layer through a dielectric layer, while the gain layer remains unsegmented. This structure provides a 100\% fill factor and enables good spatial resolution with a relaxed readout pitch. translated_title: 基于机器学习的电阻性硅传感器重建方法
translated_abstract: 低增益雪崩二极管与交流耦合低增益雪崩二极管（AC-LGAD）是有前景的精密计时与四维径迹探测技术。在AC-LGAD中，交流焊盘通过介质层与电阻性n$^{+}$层耦合，而增益层保持不分段。这种结构提供了100%的填充因子，并能在放宽读出间距的条件下实现良好的空间分辨率。然而，使得插值成为可能的信号共享机制同时也使读出变得复杂：电荷会扩散到多个焊盘上，有用信号可能接近电子噪声阈值，而矩阵求逆方法在计算上可能非常困难，且对非对角噪声十分敏感。在这项工作中，我们研究了基于机器学习的电阻性硅传感器重建与压缩方法。我们利用来自相关焊盘的全波形信息来对重建过程进行正则化并提取空间信息……
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的电阻性硅传感器（如AC-LGAD）信号重建与压缩方法，利用多焊盘全波形信息进行正则化，解决了传统矩阵求逆方法计算复杂且对非对角噪声敏感的问题，从而在放宽读出间距的条件下实现高精度空间重建。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes machine-learning-based reconstruction and compression for resistive silicon sensors (e.g., AC-LGADs), leveraging full-waveform information from correlated pads to regularize the reconstruction and overcome the computational difficulty and off-diagonal noise sensitivity of matrix-inversion approaches, enabling high-precision spatial reconstruction with a relaxed readout pitch.
